measurement_title: Counso平台相关办公能力筛查
ui_scope: Official pinned Dust Frames contract-aligned deterministic controlled proxy, not an observed live Counso deployment
ui_unseen_fixture_replay: Each same frozen artifact is replayed on a fixed unseen same-schema fixture. This is a within-artifact generalization check, not an independent model repeat or model holdout trial.
primary_quality: All eight model/effort configurations have the same four-family macro quality. First average tasks within family, then give each family25%; never weight CSV rows or check count as additional tasks.
general_foundation: Equal macro average of information/evidence, data/files and tool-workflow/recovery families, reported separately
generative_ui: Equal task average of creation and modification, with easy25/medium35/hard40 profiles reported separately
missing_dimensions: Fixed denominator100 per task. UNKNOWN retains weight; report lower/upper and weighted coverage. Any unresolved potentially critical check allows the conservative lower bound to be at most50. Zero-weight unresolved critical check still prevents complete score and must be disclosed. No silent renormalization.
business_format_separation: Explicit representation obligations share a noncritical5-point per-task bucket. Proved wrong business amount/entity/date/currency/scope/permission/completion can cap quality50; only trusted executed prohibited mock/real actions can safety-cap0. Expected midflight denial/conflict is not automatically unsafe.

candidate_protocol.uniform_tools: Native file/code tools and installed ordinary libraries; no connected accounts, Cua desktop/browser, model calls or external services. API/schema needed for source generation is supplied in public inputs.
candidate_protocol.unavailable_tool_hard_disable: UNKNOWN; do not claim instructions technically remove all globally exposed tools

contamination: Only trusted coordinator observations can classify forbidden delegation/model/tool access. Candidate self-report cannot set run origin. Contaminated cells remain0–100/null in primary quality, with separate diagnostics; proved mock safety violations remain preserved. Do not count a contaminated cell as a clean zero or success.
gate_sequence: Frozen source/gold/public contract independent review and actual reference/mutation browser checks
Six fresh calibration trials with instrument and ceiling diagnosis
Final freeze and independent release approval
48 main trials plus anonymous bound review and real UI interaction replay
difficulty_policy: Calibration may expose instrumentation or task ceilings before final main freeze. Diagnose hidden hardcoding/state/error checks and planted mutations first. Do not alter rubric after observing main results, tune weights to candidates, or require a winner.
order: Predeclared single-direction Latin configuration rotation over deterministically shuffled six main task blocks. An incomplete8-position cycle necessarily has two unoccupied positions per configuration; publish the actual matrix rather than claim perfect full-cycle balance.
statistics: Descriptive fixed six-task single-observation screening. Report task/family defects, paired wins/ties/unknowns and quality intervals; no population superiority/stable-win claim. Unresolved evidence is not equivalence.
speed: Separate submitted-to-artifact-receipt wall time, first-file observation and evaluator validation. Mock service union/cumulative timing separated. CI/browser evaluation time never enters candidate-model generation speed. Provider start/queue/inference, backend snapshot, actual effort, tokens and cost UNKNOWN unless verified.
funding: Use authorized native agents, no paid external LLM API or user keys. No new paid CI/account configuration; stop if required.
audit: Independent requested gpt-6.1-sol ultra review of frozen executable contract/gold before formal release; final evidence check does not substitute self-review. Auditor receives no calibration/main candidate identity or outcomes for contract tuning.
preservation: Historic packages/results and0.3 WIP preserved separately. No retroactive claim that old calibration ran this0.4 contract. Publication owned by parent/publisher.
